list.name: branch
list.label: Filialas
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT BranchCode FROM bi.vIncomesPayments ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(AmountEur), 0) AS [Gauta] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Mokėjimų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AmountEur < 0 THEN AmountEur END), 0) AS [Grąžinimų suma], COUNT(CASE WHEN AmountEur < 0 THEN 1 END) AS [Grąžinimų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Mokėjimai be darbuotojo] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND Employee IS NULL AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Palyginimas su ankstesniu laikotarpiu ir praėjusiais metais

targets.rawSql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime) AND d <= CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime) THEN AmountEur END), 0) AS [Pasirinktas laikotarpis], ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d >= DATEADD(day, -DATEDIFF(day, CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime), CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime)), CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime)) AND d < CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime) THEN AmountEur END), 0) AS [Ankstesnis tokios pat trukmės laikotarpis], ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d >= DATEADD(year, -1, CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime)) AND d <= DATEADD(year, -1, CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime)) THEN AmountEur END), 0) AS [Tas pats laikotarpis prieš metus] FROM (SELECT CAST(PayDate AS datetime) AS d, AmountEur FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND PayDate >= DATEADD(year, -2, CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime))) x

SELECT CAST(PayDate AS datetime) AS time, Method AS metric, SUM(AmountEur) AS value FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY PayDate, Method ORDER BY 1

SELECT BranchCode AS [Filialas], MAX(BranchName) AS [Pavadinimas], SUM(AmountEur) AS [Suma], COUNT(*) AS [Mokėjimų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT BranchCode AS [Filialas], SUM(CASE WHEN Method = 'BANK' THEN AmountEur ELSE 0 END) AS [BANK], SUM(CASE WHEN Method = 'EKA' THEN AmountEur ELSE 0 END) AS [EKA], SUM(CASE WHEN Method = 'KASA' THEN AmountEur ELSE 0 END) AS [KASA], SUM(CASE WHEN Method = 'PPK' THEN AmountEur ELSE 0 END) AS [PPK], SUM(AmountEur) AS [Iš viso] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode ORDER BY 1

SELECT TOP 1000 CONVERT(varchar(10), PayDate, 120) AS [Data], OrderNo AS [Užsakymas], BranchCode AS [Filialas], Method AS [Būdas], AmountEur AS [Suma], Employee AS [Darbuotojas] FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY PayDate DESC, PaymentKey

panels.title: Užsakymų vertė
panels.description: Vertė be anuliuotų užsakymų; skaičius apima ir anuliuotus.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 0 THEN ValueEur END), 0) AS [Užsakymų vertė], COUNT(*) AS [Užsakymų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Anuliuotų skaičius], ISNULL(SUM(ValueEur), 0) AS [Anuliuotų vertė] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 1 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) AS time, BranchCode AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY OrderDate, BranchCode ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Parduota ir gauta
panels.description: Parduota: užsakymų (be anuliuotų) vertė pagal užsakymo datą. Gauta: mokėjimai pagal mokėjimo datą.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(o.BranchCode, p.BranchCode) AS [Filialas], ISNULL(o.V, 0) AS [Parduota], ISNULL(p.V, 0) AS [Gauta], ISNULL(p.V, 0) - ISNULL(o.V, 0) AS [Skirtumas] FROM (SELECT BranchCode, SUM(ValueEur) AS V FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode) o FULL JOIN (SELECT BranchCode, SUM(AmountEur) AS V FROM bi.vIncomesPayments WHERE BranchCode IN ($branch) AND Method IN ($method) AND CAST(PayDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode) p ON o.BranchCode = p.BranchCode ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vidutinė nuolaida
panels.description: Svertinė pagal užsakymo vertę; tik užsakymai su verte > 0 ir nuolaida >= 0, be anuliuotų.

targets.rawSql: SELECT BranchCode AS [Filialas], CAST(SUM(ValueEur * DiscountPct) / NULLIF(SUM(ValueEur), 0) AS decimal(9, 2)) AS [Vidutinė nuolaida] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND ValueEur > 0 AND DiscountPct >= 0 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kainos pataisos
panels.description: Užsakymai su neigiama nuolaida (kainos pataisa aukštyn), ne nuolaida.

targets.rawSql: SELECT BranchCode AS [Filialas], COUNT(*) AS [Pataisų skaičius], ISNULL(SUM(ValueEur), 0) AS [Užsakymų vertė] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND DiscountPct < 0 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode ORDER BY 1
